thread:
Rhea: Kicking off a focused canary for v3.6.0 -> 6% on /embed. Change window 2026-07-14 23:00 UTC. Short probe 12m. Deploy-bot will post the plan.

deploy-bot: Canary start: release=v3.6.0 rollout=canary traffic=6% route=/embed id=r-1795552222
```
kubectl apply -f rollouts/r-1795552222.yaml
deployctl start --id r-1795552222 --release v3.6.0 --canary 6 --route /embed
```

SRE-bot: Baseline checks: p50/p95/p99, 5xx, mem RSS, kv-cache hitrate, embed-diff quality. Alerts will post here.

Oli: Obs ask: add embedding cosine drift monitor and batch-latency (batch size distribution). Dash: https://dash.redwood/rollouts/r-1795552222

Zara: Pinned route binding to model v3.6.0 with runtime flag: batch_max=8, kv_prefetch=false. Release notes updated in PR.

deploy-bot: Canary applied. State=UP. Running 12m smoke window.

logs-bot: SIGNAL r-1795552222: p95 +12ms (3m), 5xx=0.04%, kv-cache miss +1%, embed-cosine-drift=0.003. No memory errors.

Hannah: Looks normal so far. Continue. Keep an eye on batch latencies for small requests.

SRE-bot: ALERT r-1795552222: batch-latency 95th = 420ms (4m), baseline 250ms. Increasing tail due to packetization on canary pods.

Oli: That's notable. Can we try reconfiguring batch_max to 4 on canary to reduce tail? If we change runtime flags mid-rollout, will it require pod restart?

Zara: Changing batch_max requires rolling update of canary pods. Option: shrink traffic to 2% and restart canary pods with new flag, or stop and rollback. Thoughts?

Rhea: Proposal: shrink to 2% and rotate canary pods with batch_max=4, then probe 8m. If tail doesn't improve or 5xx >0.5% -> stop. Approve?

SRE-bot: Approve shrink+rotate. Manual stop ready if signals worsen.

deploy-bot: Updating rollout: set traffic=2% and applying flag change for canary pods id=r-1795552222
```
deployctl update --id r-1795552222 --traffic 2
kubectl set env deployment/llm-embed-v3.6.0-canary BATCH_MAX=4 --record
kubectl rollout restart deployment/llm-embed-v3.6.0-canary
```

logs-bot: SIGNAL r-1795552222: batch-latency 95th = 190ms (5m) after rotation, p95 delta back to +5ms. No 5xx.

Hannah: Nice improvement. Continue probe. Watch for embed quality drift after restart.

logs-bot: ALERT r-1795552222: embed-cosine-drift increased to 0.02 (3m) on canary. Sample: input id=enc-9923 shows embedding distance shift. See artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood/rollouts/r-1795552222/embeddings

Oli: 0.02 is above our quality gate of 0.01 for embeddings in canary. Recommend stop and rollback to v3.5.9. We should preserve sample inputs and outputs for analyzer.

Rhea: Manual STOP requested by @Oli for quality regression. Rollback plan: route -> v3.5.9, drain canary, tag image quarantined, collect embedding samples and dense diff.

deploy-bot: STOP acknowledged. Executing rollback steps:
```
route set /embed --version=3.5.9
scale deployment llm-embed-v3.6.0 --replicas=0
kubectl annotate deployment llm-embed-v3.6.0 quarantined-by=obs-1795552222
collect-artifacts --id r-1795552222 --artifacts=embed-samples,heap-dump,kvcache-stats
```

SRE-bot: Rollback in progress. Preserve logs and artifacts TTL for triage.

Zara: Updating release notes: "Canary v3.6.0 rolled back to v3.5.9 due to embedding quality drift after batch config change. Preserved samples for analysis." Tags: rollback, embeddings, canary.

Rhea: Confirmed rollback. Opening ticket R-9981 to investigate embedding drift and interaction with batching/runtime flags. Owners: @Zara, @Oli, @SRE-bot. Quick sync scheduled 2026-07-14 23:30 UTC.

Hannah: Thanks team for quick detection and safe rollback. We'll run extended embed-regression tests before next attempt. :sparkles:
